summary: Gates G4, G5 and G6 fail. Board standoff pilots are 1.70 mm (M2) not 2.4-2.6; the lid has no vent slots at all; lid-boss pilots are 6.1 deep (needs 7.6) and the lid is a lip-in-wall plate, not the required rebate form. Plug openings, board clearance, keep-outs, shells and size pass. Score is an estimate.

defects.where: base.stl, 4 standoff pilots at (14.0,2.5), (15.3,50.7), (66.1,7.6), (66.1,35.5), Z -5.1 to 0; open_iso.png / ghost_top.png
defects.what: Standoff pilots are sized for M2 (layout.json declares screw_m2_selftap) instead of M3
Pilot too shallow for a 10 mm screw through the 1.6 board

defects.where: lid.stl plate Z 15.8-18.2; expected row at X 30.2-65.8, Y 11.2-24.8 (V-VENT); ghost_top.png / model_top.png
defects.what: No ventilation slots exist; the lid has only the 4 screw holes (ray casts at 3 lid positions hit 2 faces only, SCAD has no vent cut)
defects.expected: 5-9 slots, 1.5-3.0 x 8-12, pitch 3.5-6.5, inside V-VENT, area >= 100 mm2

defects.what: All other vent L3s fail with the slots missing (width/length, pitch, straight row span >= 21.4, area >= 100, ligament)

defects.where: lid.stl: plate Z 15.8-18.2 on top of wall tops (Z 15.8) with lip Z 13.7-15.8 inside the walls; open_iso.png
defects.what: Wrong lid form: plate sits on the wall tops with a lip inside the walls; there is no rebate or upstand, so no flush upstand/plate relation. F2 forbids a lip-in-wall lid
defects.expected: rebate in wall tops, upstand >= 1.0, depth = plate thickness +-0.3, plate flush with upstand within 0.3
defects.observed: no rebate, no upstand; plate 2.4 thick on a flat wall top, lip 0.25 per side

defects.where: base.stl -X wall USB opening Y 29.7-46.5, Z 0.2-14.0
defects.what: Rectangular USB opening has a flat 16.8 mm roof (bridge) with no 45 degree roof
Self-report claims pilot dia 2.500 and vent/lid checks pass or are unlinked; judge measures 1.70 pilots and no vents
